ignorePatterns:
worker-configuration.d.ts
pnpm-lock.yaml
src/generated/**
specs/google-calendar-v3.openapi.json
specs/zoom-meetings.openapi.json
.wrangler/**
dist/**

rules.rule: Every provider route (POST /zoom/webhook, POST /slack/*, POST /google/notify) verifies the request signature against the raw body before the body is parsed. Flag any handler that reads or parses the body first.

Personal join_url values, join tokens, the Zoom host key, GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY, signed JWT assertions, access tokens and the calendar watch token never go into `log.*` or `notifyBotLog` fields. Log event names and ids only.
CRON_TO_KIND in src/bots/reminders and `triggers.crons` in wrangler.jsonc must match byte-for-byte (ADR 0005). Flag a change to one without the other.
A new non-secret entry in wrangler.jsonc `vars` needs a matching hand-typed field in src/env.ts (then `pnpm cf-types`). Secrets (`*_TOKEN`, `*_SECRET`, `*_KEY`) never go in `vars`.
